hypothesis: Persistent member-specific missing-feature contexts plus factual/masked own CE and common CORE-style reconstruction can teach useful graph-dependent member decisions under a live shared backbone.
root_only_actions: comparison/table and objective/selection binding before outcomes
unused confirmation if exploratory screen succeeds
graph: complete PubMed Planetoid official graph/split; developmental nomination pending root exposure audit
backbone: root-qualified capable native PubMed recipe and existing internal-BE sites; exact config/full horizon/optimizer/transition/selector must be bound without outcome tuning before admission

views.masked: one fixed disjoint quarter of eligible nonzero-feature nodes per member, features zeroed before whole predictor; unchanged A
views.partitions: equal as possible, label-free fixed hash ordering salt masked-context-BE-v1; no node-ID embedding or raw-target skip
views.reconstruction_decoder: single common linear hidden-to-raw-feature map across members, discarded at serving
views.negative_type: other masked reconstructed vectors, without replacement
views.zero_features: remain all classification populations, omitted as reconstruction anchors

serving: original graph/features; all four factual probability vectors; unchanged arithmetic mean; no auxiliary decoder/no masked test views
ownership_control: every update uses the identical four masked views and anchor/negative mass; a separate outcome-blind stream permutes member ownership; fixed whole-fit permutation is a renaming check, not another fit
auxiliary_rewire: fixed label-free double-edge swaps preserving degrees, node/feature order, self edges and declared duplicate policy; root must bind canonical representation, swap count/rejection cap/fingerprint before data-dependent scientific work; cannot replace a failed control after outcomes
main_decisions: whole factual served accuracy/NLL gains over own-only and masked-CE controls
strong capable single and ordinary/objective-matched independent references
mean and worst own-member safeguards frozen by root
all repairs and harms/common wrong rivals/coverage retained
same-aux single match removes ensemble explanation
weaker members/no net pooled utility rejects hypothesis
inference_limits: graph-feature targets are transductive allowed-feature supervision, not external labels
global attention can access nonneighbors, so rewire is conditional local-evidence test
known ingredients do not disqualify a distinct evidenced composition; bounded nonmatch is not novelty clearance
three optimizer seeds on one graph are exploratory, not independent graph confirmation
